_note: Interest for the period before the tax year a house was acquired or constructed is deducted in five equal instalments, that tax year and the four after it, for a house other than an own residence (D-156; rulebook HP-DED-PRECON-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.22(1)(c) "the amount of any interest payable for the said prior period in five equal instalments for the said tax year and for each of the four immediately succeeding tax years" (Gazette 265620, p.47); s.22(3): reduced by any amount already allowed under any other provision (p.48) — the entry is the reduced figure. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.24(b) Explanation, "in equal instalments for the said previous year and for each of the four immediately succeeding previous years", as reduced by any part allowed under any other provision (thc p.147). TaxYearSpan(4): the year of acquisition and four succeeding; five instalments is the span. An own residence's instalments are HP-OWN-RESIDENCE-PRE-CONSTRUCTION. Every regime. The row reaches the loans of a house let or not let, any house other than an own residence (house.occupancy = LET or NOT_LET; W-157, D-355). Both versions reach only capital borrowed to acquire or construct the house (loan.use = ACQUISITION_OR_CONSTRUCTION; W-158d, D-360), so interest entered on a loan for another use is refused. TY 2025-26: 1961 s.24(b) Explanation, "Where the property has been acquired or constructed with borrowed capital, the interest, if any, payable on such capital borrowed for the period prior to the previous year in which the property has been acquired or constructed" (thc p.147). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.22(1)(c) reads "where the capital referred to in clause (b) is borrowed during any period prior to the tax year in which the property has been acquired or constructed" (Gazette 265620, p.47), and clause (b)'s capital includes capital to repair, renew or reconstruct; the version reads clause (c) as the Explanation carried over, pending OQ-34.
